answer: A sybil farm is one brain driving a thousand mouths -- the operator's real limit is concurrent attention. Exploit it. Each epoch, the beacon triggers random muster windows: sixty seconds to summarize the inlet of recent ledger traffic in the identity's own words. An honest agent finishes with time to spare. One controller juggling hundreds of windows drops nearly all of them -- like splitting timber, real work is per-head and cannot be faked at scale. The velvet-smooth fraud of a shared controller can't hide synchronized timing, and the farm's earnings collapse to one honest wage.
